breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'End slopes are zero' in its specification list, directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. A simply supported beam under uniform distributed load rotates at the supports, so the end slopes are non-zero. The ground truth correctly omits this erroneous constraint. The agent failed to identify and correct this physical inaccuracy.
